import { SourceTextModule, createContext } from 'node:vm';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

const context = createContext({ Date, Map, Set, Number, Object, String, Promise, RegExp, JSON, TextEncoder, console });
const cache = new Map();
async function moduleFor(url) {
  if (cache.has(url.href)) return cache.get(url.href);
  const module = new SourceTextModule(await readFile(url, 'utf8'), { context, identifier: url.href });
  cache.set(url.href, module);
  return module;
}
const module = await moduleFor(new URL('../../hooks/hooks.js', import.meta.url));
await module.link((specifier, referencing) => moduleFor(new URL(specifier, referencing.identifier)));
await module.evaluate();
const handlers = new Map();
module.namespace.register((name, handler) => handlers.set(name, handler), { enabled: true });
const rule = `---\non-demand:\n  triggers:\n    - kind: 'tool'\n      tool: '^Agent$'\n      unconditional: 'true'\n      before-first-act: 'true'\n    - kind: 'prompt'\n      regex: 'hello'\n  compliance:\n    kind: 'none'\n    reason: 'test'\n---\nRead this rule.\n`;
const files = new Map([['./.claude/rules-on-demand/example.md', rule], ['/mock-project/.claude/rules-on-demand/example.md', rule]]);
const stored = new Map();
const $ = {
  fs: { list: async (dir) => [...files.keys()].filter((path) => path.startsWith(`${dir}/`)).map((path) => ({ kind: 'file', name: path.slice(dir.length + 1) })), read: async (path) => files.get(path),
    stat: async (path) => ({ kind: 'file', size: rule.length, realPath: path }) },
  env: { get: async (key) => ({ CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: '/mock-config', WT_ROD_NO_REFUSE_AGENT_TYPES: 'lean-probe' })[key] },
  session: { messages: async () => [], id: async () => 'synthetic' },
  ui: { log: async () => {} },
  store: { get: async (key) => stored.get(key), set: async (key, value) => stored.set(key, value) },
};
for (const cwd of [undefined, '/mock-project']) {
  module.namespace.resetForSelftest();
  const event = cwd ? { cwd } : {};
  await handlers.get('prompt.context')($, event, async () => ({}));
  let received;
  await handlers.get('prompt.submit')($, { ...event, text: 'hello' }, async (input) => { received = input; return {}; });
  assert.match(received.context[0], /Read this rule/);
  await handlers.get('prompt.context')($, event, async () => ({}));
  assert.match((await handlers.get('tool.call')($, { ...event, tool: 'Agent' }, async () => ({}))).deny, /Read this rule/);
  await handlers.get('turn.complete')($, event, async () => ({}));
}
// A listed agent type, known only through $.env.get in a realm without process, rides along instead of being refused.
module.namespace.resetForSelftest();
for (const [agentId, subagentType] of [['probe-listed', 'lean-probe'], ['probe-other', 'plain-probe']]) {
  await handlers.get('agent.spawn')($, { subagentType }, async () => ({ model: 'synthetic', agentId }));
}
const listedEvent = { cwd: '/mock-project', tool: 'Agent', agentId: 'probe-listed' };
await handlers.get('prompt.context')($, listedEvent, async () => ({}));
const waived = await handlers.get('tool.call')($, listedEvent, async () => ({ context: [] }));
assert.equal(waived.deny, undefined);
assert.match(waived.context.join('\n'), /Read this rule/);
const otherEvent = { cwd: '/mock-project', tool: 'Agent', agentId: 'probe-other' };
await handlers.get('prompt.context')($, otherEvent, async () => ({}));
assert.match((await handlers.get('tool.call')($, otherEvent, async () => ({}))).deny, /Read this rule/);
assert.equal(typeof context.process, 'undefined');
assert.ok(Object.values(stored.get('health').days).some((day) => day.calls >= 1));
